name: ODYSSEY 102
notes: Eight lower bedrooms confirmed by the owner. Other V2 geometry retained.

reviewFlags.title: Faint side access needs confirmation
reviewFlags.text: PDF note 37 points to the faint mark beside the accommodation stair landing. It is drawn as an outward-opening side door with clear wall returns; the original sketch does not establish this entrance conclusively.

reviewFlags.title: Changes in height remain schematic
reviewFlags.text: The short workshop/fuel flights now share a landing as reviewed. Their exact elevations and which levels each flight serves are not measured by the sketches.

reviewFlags.title: Eight lower bedrooms confirmed; other accommodation unlocated
reviewFlags.text: The owner confirmed eight lower-level bedrooms, four on each side of the hall. The written specification lists twenty; additional accommodation remains unlocated and has not been invented.

reviewFlags.title: Service identities and storage access
reviewFlags.text: Boiler/furnace and tank labels follow the sketch. The storage entrance is conventionally placed from the adjoining passage; exact service partitions and tank identities remain unverified.

reviewFlags.title: Dimensions remain schematic
reviewFlags.text: The helipad retains the marked 43:35 proportion. Other room lengths, stair elevations, hull form and physical door/fixture sizes have not been surveyed.

sourceSummary: The owner confirmed eight lower-level bedrooms on 16 November: four per side with the same alternating bed/desk arrangement. V3 corrects that block; earlier revisions remain archived. Other source uncertainties remain in Feedback.

revisionMeta.label: V3 · Eight-room correction
revisionMeta.summary: Owner-confirmed eight lower-level bedrooms: four per side, with a common alternating bed/desk layout and closets opposite doorways on the hallway wall. Other floor geometry remains as in V2.

changes.title: Eight rooms, four per side
changes.text: Removed the extra paired row while retaining the common room size. The schematic lower outline and end exit now stop after the fourth pair. L1–L4 and R1–R4 remain provisional location identifiers.

changes.title: One repeated bedroom layout
changes.text: A top doorway has a top bed and a bottom desk; the alternate room reverses that arrangement. Left and right rooms mirror across the central hallway.

changes.title: Closets opposite doors on the hallway wall
changes.text: Retained the closet relationship confirmed by the owner, coordinated with each doorway and the common room proportions.

changes.title: Shared geometry for sketch and Studio
changes.text: The corrected review sketch and editor project use the same four-row geometry. Other walls, stairs, shared facilities and upper floor are unchanged from their respective review versions.

changes.title: Use the owner-supplied desk-chair icon
changes.text: The supplied chair.svg replaces the draft chair symbol. Its proportions are retained, its facing follows the desk, and the renderer applies the shared drawing colour and fixture line weight.
